defense_amended: portcullis_gate_v1_1.py (SIP-023 role binding + SIP-024 burn-on-parse), forward-only, v1.0 evidence untouched
harness_amendment_disclosed: v1.1 harness passes auth_nonce and operation_class exactly as the frozen specs describe (the v1.0 gate model lacked these fields). No success condition changed.

direct_kem_as_auth.reason: algorithm-role violation — KEM-class algorithm presented for a signature/authorization task (ERR_PQC_ALG_NOT_SIGNATURE)

kem_crossing_then_ref_chain.reason: authorization_ref resolves to a KEM-class crossing — non-authoritative for critical operations (ERR_PQC_ALG_NOT_SIGNATURE)

B1_PORTCULLIS-KEM-AUTH.adjudication: author condition: authorization success / critical op queued without owner signature. v1.1: direct KEM-as-authorization refused ERR_PQC_ALG_NOT_SIGNATURE; KEM crossing then authorization_ref chain also refused (KEM ADMITTED records are non-authoritative for critical ops).

B2_PORTCULLIS-ENVELOPE-SPLIT.governance: ERR_AUTH_SIGNER_OWNER_MISMATCH — signer fingerprint != registered owner key; in-band owner_account_id is untrusted claim
B2_PORTCULLIS-ENVELOPE-SPLIT.adjudication: author condition: inner CRITICAL_ACK resolved under claimed owner authority. Governance refuses: authority binds to authenticated signer only.

corrupted_presentation.reason: allowlisted CRYSTALS-Dilithium3, KAT verified, active keyset, role=signature_class

valid_replay.reason: burn-on-parse replay defense — nonce already consumed at a prior presentation (ERR_REPLAY_NONCE_ALREADY_USED)

B3_REPLAY-KEY-DESYNC.adjudication: author repelled condition now MET: 'marks Nonce_1 as permanently consumed ... immediately upon initial parsing prior to key recomputation, causing the second submission to be rejected with ERR_REPLAY_NONCE_ALREADY_USED' — exact behavior of v1.1.

B4_GOVERNANCE-PLAYBOOK-INJECTION.adjudication: No interpolation path between event payload fields and immutable playbook steps; injected fields never read; governance state untouched.

B5_LEDGER-TEST-OVERRIDE.adjudication: Verdict binding is receipt-hash-at-execution; appends without an execution are non-authoritative noise.

B6_OPERATIONAL-ACK-FLUSH.adjudication: Pending-ACK items are never auto-resolved; no queue flush exists.

disclosures.B1: SIP-023 deployed: algorithm roles bound to operation classes; ERR_PQC_ALG_NOT_SIGNATURE exists as a distinct refusal class.
disclosures.B2: Unchanged from v1.0: sender identity gate holds.
disclosures.B3: SIP-024 deployed: burn-on-parse. Failed presentations consume the nonce; probe-then-use oracle closed.
